name: Maria Placeholder

transcript.text: What problems or symptoms are you having right now?
For the last two weeks I get breathless when I climb the stairs, and I have to stop halfway.
Since when has this been happening, and how bad is it?
It started about two weeks ago. Now even walking to the market makes me tired. My ankles also swell by the evening.
Is there anything else you are feeling that you want the doctor to know?
I feel tired most days. I am allergic to penicillin, it gives me a rash. I was getting trastuzumab every three weeks, but they stopped it in September.
Do you have any earlier medical records, like test reports, scans, prescriptions or discharge summaries?
Yes, I have my biopsy report from February and three heart scan reports, the echo tests, from Heart Associates.
Which ones, and roughly when and where were they done?
The echoes were in March, June and September this year. A repeat echo was ordered for October but I have not done it yet.
Thank you. Please upload those records in your profile, and I will share this with your doctor.

details.current_treatment: Weekly paclitaxel with trastuzumab from March 2025; trastuzumab on hold since September
